title: Self Employed Tax Deduction Tracker, Quarterly Estimated Tax Spreadsheet, Schedule C, 1099 Mileage Log, US Freelancer Excel Google Sheets
description:
Know what to pay the IRS each quarter, and keep every deduction on its Schedule C line. For US 1099 freelancers, sole proprietors and side hustlers, tax years 2026 and 2027.

Log income, costs and miles. It puts each deduction on its Schedule C line, applies the IRS standard mileage rate by trip date, works out self-employment tax and a federal income tax estimate, and shows your safe-harbor amount and what to pay on each 1040-ES due date.
